就在陈阳放松身心之时，突然咔擦一声，浴室门推开，一道女人的声音从外面传来：“嘿嘿，让我看看是谁在洗澡，姐姐帮你按摩按摩，保证舒服。”
陈阳打了个激灵，条件反射地抓起旁边的盆子挡住了身子，朝浴室门口看去，一名只围了浴巾，露出白皙香肩的女孩，笑嘻嘻地出现在浴室门口。
两人四目相对，叶以晴的笑容瞬间僵硬在脸上，她完全没有料到，浴室里竟然会出现一个她从没见过的男子，而且没有穿衣服。
如今的小偷这么大胆了，偷完东西还要洗个澡？
“你是谁？”
“你是谁？”
同样的疑问，从陈阳和叶以晴的口中发出，两人又是一愣，显然都有些懵了。
陈阳这才打量起女孩的样貌，完美的瓜子脸，水淋淋的大眼睛，白皙的皮肤，凹凸有致的身材，这完全就是个女神级别的美人，全天下男人都会为之深陷。
可是，她为什么会出现在自己的房子里？更关键的是，她还一直盯着自己猛看。
“女流氓，你看什么看？”
陈阳叫了声，叶以晴这才回过神来，连忙把盯着对方的目光收回。
虽然有盆子遮挡，她什么也没看见，但还是俏脸一红，眉宇间满是愤怒之色，一脚就朝陈阳踢了过来，骂道：“私闯民宅，竟然还敢在这洗澡，反了啊你！”
叶以晴这一脚踢起来很高，直奔陈阳的脸上来，但因为她围着浴巾的缘故，下摆顿时大大敞开，眼看就要走光了。
她一见陈阳视线不对劲，腿还没踢到陈阳，就连忙收了回来，双腿夹得紧紧的，气得血都快吐出来了。
想要继续动手，叶以晴又怕走光，岂不白白便宜了这小偷。
她咬牙切齿地瞪了眼陈阳，砰一声把浴室门关上，在外面大声叫道：“混蛋，赶紧把衣服穿好给我滚出来，不然的话，老娘进去收拾你。”
“这女孩长得倒是漂亮，就是脾气太火爆了。”
陈阳嘟哝一句，却是一点也不着急，继续不急不缓地洗着澡，就算女孩再不爽，可这是我的房子，难道洗个澡还要看你脸色不成。
至于突然出现的女孩，陈阳已经想明白了，没人会裹着浴巾闯入别人家的浴室，那么只有一个可能，女孩是这里的房客。
现在陈阳所在的这个四合院，是他从爷爷那里继承得来，今天刚到就在浴室洗了个澡，却没想到这个四合院里竟然还有个美女房客。

想想刚才那个不仅脾气火爆，身材也火爆的女孩，陈阳在想那会不会也是爷爷留给自己的遗产。
“想什么呢，爷爷那么正直的人，怎么可能做出这种事情。”
陈阳目光正然，嘴角却勾起一抹笑意，搓着身上的泡沫，在浴室里吹起了小曲。
口哨声刚起，浴室门就被拍得砰砰砰地直响，叶以晴在外面喊道：“混蛋，你竟然还吹起了口哨，给你一分钟的时间穿好衣服，不然老娘可要把你反锁在里面了。”
“我擦，这么嚣张。不过我大人大量，不和你计较。”
陈阳瘪了瘪嘴，只当没听到女孩的声音，继续在浴室里洗澡。
又过了一会，浴室门咔哒响了声，愤怒的声音传来：“我现在把门反锁，你就别想出来了。”
“嘿嘿，一扇门就想困住我，当我绰号‘上帝’是白叫的。”
陈阳笑了笑，继续吹起了口哨。
听到口哨声，门外的叶以晴气得头都要炸了，她从来没见过这么嚣张的小偷，在房里洗澡被人逮住，竟然还有心情吹口哨，实在太不要脸了。
“待会他出来，我一定要揍得他满地找牙！”
叶以晴狠狠地说道，低头看了眼自己裹着的浴巾，连忙朝着房间跑去，生怕小偷逃走，迅速穿上外套和裤子，又急匆匆地回到了浴室门口。
听到里面的口哨还没停下，叶以晴放下心来：“让你嚣张，等下揍你一顿，再把你抓回警局。”
过了一会，浴室里的水声停了下来，传来窸窸窣窣穿衣服的声音。
叶以晴原本以为小偷会求她开门，可是却没有传来动静，她皱了下眉头，耳朵朝着浴室门贴过去，想听听里面到底是什么情况。
就在她耳朵靠在浴室门的刹那，门一下看着她。

content_en:
Just when Chen Yang was relaxing, there was a sudden click, the bathroom door opened, and a woman's voice came from outside: "Hey, let me see who is taking a bath. My sister will give you a massage to make sure you are comfortable."
Chen Yang shuddered and reflexively grabbed the basin next to him to block his body. He looked towards the bathroom door. A girl wearing only a bath towel and showing her fair shoulders appeared at the bathroom door with a smile.
The two looked at each other, and Ye Yiqing's smile instantly froze on her face. She did not expect that a man she had never seen before would appear in the bathroom, and he was not wearing any clothes.
Today's thieves are so bold, why do they still need to take a shower after stealing?
"Who are you?"
"Who are you?"
The same question came from the mouths of Chen Yang and Ye Yiqing. They were stunned again, obviously a little confused.
Only then did Chen Yang take stock of the girl's appearance. She had a perfect oval face, big watery eyes, fair skin, and a curvy figure. She was a goddess-level beauty, and men all over the world would fall in love with her.
But why did she appear in her house? More importantly, she kept staring at herself.
"Female gangster, what are you looking at?"
Chen Yang shouted, and Ye Yiqing came back to her senses and quickly looked away from him.
Although she didn't see anything because of the basin, she still blushed, her brows filled with anger, and kicked Chen Yang, cursing: "You broke into a private house and dared to take a bath here, you're contrary to that!"
Ye Yiqing's kick was very high and went straight to Chen Yang's face. However, because she was wearing a bath towel, the hem was suddenly wide open and she was about to be exposed.
When she saw something was wrong with Chen Yang's gaze, she quickly pulled back her legs before she could kick Chen Yang. She clamped her legs tightly and was so angry that she almost vomited blood.
Ye Yiqing wanted to continue taking action, but she was afraid of being exposed. Wouldn't it be a waste of money for the thief?
She gritted her teeth and glared at Chen Yang, slammed the bathroom door, and shouted outside: "Asshole, quickly put on your clothes and get out, or else, I'll go in and deal with you."
"This girl is pretty, but she has a hot temper."
Chen Yang muttered, but he was not in a hurry at all and continued to take a bath unhurriedly. No matter how upset the girl was, this is my house. Do you have to look at your face to take a bath?
As for the girl who suddenly appeared, Chen Yang had already figured it out. No one would break into someone else's bathroom wrapped in a bath towel, so there was only one possibility: the girl was a tenant here.
The courtyard where Chen Yang lives now was inherited from his grandfather. He took a shower in the bathroom when he arrived today, but he didn't expect that there was a beautiful tenant in this courtyard.
Thinking about the girl just now who not only had a hot temper, but also had a hot figure, Chen Yang wondered if that was also the legacy left to him by his grandfather.
"What are you thinking about? How could a man as upright as grandpa do such a thing?"
Chen Yang's eyes were serious, but a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth. He rubbed the foam on his body and played a tune in the bathroom.
As soon as the whistle sounded, the bathroom door banged loudly. Ye Yiqing shouted outside: "Asshole, you even whistled. I give you one minute to get dressed, otherwise I will lock you in."
"Oh no, you are so arrogant. But I, my lord, don't care about you."
Chen Yang pursed his lips, pretending he didn't hear the girl's voice, and continued taking a bath in the bathroom.
After a while, the bathroom door clicked, and an angry voice came: "I'll lock the door now, so you can't get out."
"Hey, a door is trying to trap me. My nickname is 'God' for nothing."
Chen Yang smiled and continued to whistle.
Hearing the whistle, Ye Yiqing outside the door was so angry that her head almost exploded. She had never seenIt was so shameless for such an arrogant thief to be caught taking a shower in the room and still be in the mood to whistle.
"When he comes out later, I will beat him until he is full of teeth!"
Ye Yiqing said harshly, looking down at the bath towel she was wrapped in, and quickly ran towards the room. For fear of the thief escaping, she quickly put on her coat and pants, and hurried back to the bathroom door.
Hearing the whistle inside that hadn't stopped yet, Ye Yiqing felt relieved: "I'll let you be arrogant. I'll beat you up later and then take you back to the police station."
After a while, the sound of water in the bathroom stopped, and there was the sound of rustling clothes being put on.
Ye Yiqing originally thought that the thief would beg her to open the door, but there was no movement. She frowned and put her ear to the bathroom door, wanting to hear what was going on inside.
The moment she leaned her ear against the bathroom door, the door looked at her.
